description: Take a visit the rep logged off their account record, e.g. one logged twice or on the wrong surgeon. Pick it by its id (visits[].id on the record) or by the surgeon's NPI and the day it is logged on. Only the rep who logged it can; it cannot be brought back, so say which visit it is and remove it only when the rep agrees. Where the account stands, its follow-ups and notes stay as they are. A connected HubSpot's copy is removed too. To fix a day or a note, use edit_visit instead.

npi.description: 10-digit NPI; use search to find it.

on.description: With npi instead of an id: the day the visit is logged on, YYYY-MM-DD.

visit.description: The visit's id, from the record's visits.

name: delete_visit
title: Remove a visit
